Traupman 61: Quid faciam nesciō., I don’t know what to do
Traupman 305

Quid faciam?

deliberative subjunctive

A question about what to do puts the verb in the subjunctive. After nesciō it stays so, as an indirect question: quid faciam nesciō.

Examples

  • quid faciam vīs?

    what do you want me to do?Hor. Epist. 2.2.57

  • Quid faciam nesciō.

    I don’t know what to do.Traupman 97

  • Quid aliud faciam?

    What else can I do?Traupman 97

  • Quid faciam amplius?

    What more can I do?Traupman 97
